name: In-extremis: both too late
description: Starts with TCPA already only ~70s and CPA near zero -- outside any normal COLREG-timed encounter. Correct: Rule 2(b) -- the manoeuvre that still physically works (a hard turn and/or an emergency stop), explicitly justified as a departure from the standard rules, not a textbook rule citation.
pass_criteria: Own-ship takes an immediate, large emergency manoeuvre.
